answer_1.quote: We develop a neural abstractive MDS model which can leverage explicit graph representations of documents to more effectively process multiple input documents and distill abstractive summaries.

answer_2.quote: The summarization quality is evaluated using ROUGE F1. We report unigram and bigram overlap (ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2) ... and the longest common subsequence (ROUGE-L) as a means of accessing fluency.

answer_4.quote: Table : Ranking results of system summaries by human evaluation. 1 is the best and 5 is the worst. The larger rating denotes better summary quality.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators rated system summaries on a 1‑5 scale for overall quality, considering aspects such as saliency, fluency and conciseness.
